items.description: Laptop screen and lower-right corner impact damage
items.rationale: If portable-equipment cover is in force and the laptop is insured household property, §§2.6.2–2.6.3 and 4.5.2 cover both impact areas as one event; the missing schedule and third-party invoice add uncertainty. Under §7.1.10, Case 2 supports about €810 for the screen plus €350 for the corner, or €1,160 gross, below the €1,400 new-equivalent benchmark; no deductible is stated.
